title: Review of c02's FCH chemoton: vesicles form from noise on fresh seed 7, but K-free rings persist as well as K-carrying ones, a local feed cut around one K-vesicle shrinks every vesicle in the box by 18-37%, and an ungated twin with slow catalyst diffusion keeps K alive as bath spots off the bilayers
summary: Re-ran world.py unchanged on fresh seed 7 (192^2, t=600): two K-carrying vesicles (a figure-8 and a trimer, dark precursor halos) and three K-free rings form from noise by t~130 and all five persist to t=600 (rerun/sheet.png; bodymass.json: K-free rings 729-784 -> 777-813, K-vesicles 661-1272 -> 629-1413). Local feed cuts with world_c25.py (F=0 in a disk from t=300, everything else identical): around the K-trimer (r=40 px) it contracts into a compact 3-micelle cluster (amphiphile -37% by t=600 vs -5% fed; K -54%) but does not vanish, and every other body also shrinks by 18-25% (fed: +2% to +11%), including K-free rings 60-120 px away; around a K-free ring (r=35) that ring changes little (-5% vs +4% fed). So amphiphile is a shared pool: K-vesicles feed the bath and every bilayer lives on it, and the dependence is collective, not per individual. A twin without the gate and with uniform DK=0.001 (twin_DK001) keeps K alive (K total -39% vs -80%) as Gray-Scott spots and rings in the bath, mostly off the bilayers, while vesicles persist and amphiphile rises 60%: the K layer on bilayers is the gate's doing (a mobility written against u), and K's survival needs only slow diffusion.

observations.S: rerun/sheet.png t=0: uniform noise; micelles by t=24, rings by t=51
observations.I: rerun/sheet.png: five discrete bilayer bodies of fixed position and bounded size from t~130 to 600

seeds_run.result: vesicles form and persist (pass for S, I); K-free rings persist as well as K-carrying ones

controls_run.E: cutK_s7 and cutfree_s7 (local feed cut from t=300 around one body, world_c25.py) vs rerun (fed twin, identical before t=300): bodymass.json
controls_run.B: twin_DK001 (gate=0, DK uniform 0.001): K survives as bath spots off the bilayers

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed and one cut per body type; the cut disk (r=35-40 px) may not fully starve a body because the precursor diffuses ~20 px into it, so the starved K-trimer's survival as a cluster may be partial feeding. B: the K layer exists on K-carrying vesicles, but it is placed there by a mobility gate written against u; K makes itself there, which arguably passes the RUBRIC L3 self-made clause, so I list B as by construction rather than contradicted. E: amphiphile is made only by K from the precursor and decays, so the dependence is by construction, and the local cuts show it acts on the shared bath pool, not per vesicle. The uniform-DK twin is one value (0.001), not matched to the gated mobility, and its vesicles grow rather than stay the same, so it is not a like-for-like copy of the world.
